write_arrow_records: write individual records to an Arrow IPC stream using ArrowWriter with a schema
write_arrow_batches: write batched records to an Arrow IPC stream using ArrowWriter write_batch method
write_parquet_records: write individual records to a Parquet file using ParquetWriter with content-defined chunking
create_typed_sequence: create a PyArrow array from a TypedSequence with automatic or explicit type inference
create_optimized_typed_sequence: create a PyArrow array from an OptimizedTypedSequence that picks dtypes based on column name
